production_and_use.comparison_basis: Each 2026 observation is indexed to the same calendar date in 2025; 100 means unchanged. Seven-day summaries use the same calendar week.
caveats: The public workbook does not state the flow unit, so levels are for comparative use only.
Published production covers public pipelines and excludes non-public Kapuni data.
Same-calendar differences are descriptive context, not estimates of an Iran-crisis effect.
Ahuroa is one storage facility, not New Zealand's national gas inventory.
Balance above cushion is closing balance minus published cushion gas; it is not a claim about accessible or deliverable supply.
Only the source's latest daily observations are charted; older monthly history is excluded.

domestic_energy_context.model_usage: Observed domestic energy-buffer context only. These gas metrics do not alter the liquid-fuel model until a substitution relationship passes holdout testing.

assumptions: NZ imports roughly 60% of refined fuel from refineries dependent on Hormuz crude (live model parameter: 61.5% / 0.62)
Stock data uses MBIE fuel stock and shipping updates when available; quarterly MBIE Oil Statistics are a fallback
Operational pressure uses effective total cover: in-country stock plus on-water stock adjusted for assumed rerouting delays
Depletion model assumes linear consumption and constant disruption fraction
Cape of Good Hope rerouting adds ~14 days to tanker transit when Hormuz disruption >30%
MSO minimums: petrol 28d, diesel 21d, jet fuel 24d (per Jan 2025 regulations)
MSO compliance is withheld because national aggregate stock does not establish compliance by each obliged importer; only in-country and within-EEZ stock is legally eligible
The scenario threshold is 14 days of effective physical cover; it is not a rationing forecast
Industry cascade thresholds are domain estimates, not empirically calibrated
Fuel-price change is measured against the mean for 15 January to 27 February 2026
Price data from MBIE weekly monitoring — typically a 1 week publication lag

data_sources.fuel_prices: MBIE Weekly Fuel Price Monitoring (direct file or Figure.NZ archive of the MBIE source file) + Gaspy live daily stats (reference snapshot)
data_sources.fuel_stocks: MBIE fuel stock and shipping updates (in-country, within-EEZ, and outside-EEZ source split) + MBIE Quarterly Oil Statistics fallback
data_sources.hormuz_traffic: IMF PortWatch daily chokepoint crossings preferred; Sentinel-1 SAR vessel density is exported separately
data_sources.upstream_market: Yahoo Finance daily futures and FX (reference series)
data_sources.retail_basket: Woolworths NZ anonymous public product search API (daily reference basket)
data_sources.port_calls: Port of Auckland + Port of Tauranga public vessel schedule pages
data_sources.domestic_gas: Gas Industry Company production, consumption, and Ahuroa storage workbooks
